passages.excerpt: A completed Residential Accessory Dwelling Unit (RADU) application and ADU Verification Form are required for all ADU and JADU projects.
ADU Verification Form (contact the Planning Team at planning@cityofirvine.org
A completed ADU Permit Application
Building plans, calculations, and construction documents
Development Standards Checklist for Site Plan
Covenant (obtain copy from Planning at planning@cityofirvine.org. Document will need to be notarized; recorded with County of Orange Recorder’s office when notified by case planner)
Your application package must be submitted online using the IrvineReady! Online Permit Submittal Portal.
After submitting your plans, City staff will review the information for completeness within approximately two business days. If additional information is needed, you will be notified.
You will be emailed a link to pay required fees.
After payment is received, your project will be processed for review.
Refer to Government Code section 65852.2 subdivisions (d)(1-5) and j(10) for more information.

milestones.title: Completeness review

published_clock.scope: City staff initial completeness review of an ADU submittal; not an approval forecast

milestones._statutory_note: HCD Handbook (p.34, citing Gov. Code § 66317(a)(2)(A)) says completeness must be determined within 15 business days, and the application is deemed complete if the agency misses it (p.35). Handbook only; statute text blocked. The city's own target (approx. 2 business days) is shorter and is what published_clock shows.

published_clock.scope: Approve or deny an ADU permit application, counted from receipt of a completed application, where a dwelling exists on the lot (per HCD Handbook, citing Gov. Code § 66317(a)(3)). Tolled if the applicant requests a delay.
published_clock.verification: handbook_only: statute text not opened (LEGINFO-66317 blocked). Display only; no due-date arithmetic.

milestones.title: Permit issuance (permit fees paid at issuance)

conflicts.summary: Spec §8 lists plan review before fee/payment readiness. The city's ADU page says fees are paid after the completeness check and the project is processed for review only after payment; the Fee Schedule says the plan check fee is paid at plan submittal and permit fees at issuance. This manifest orders plan check fee payment before plan review and attaches permit fees to permit issuance. Team to confirm.

Stale citation: Form 67-01 (Rev 01/25) refers applicants to Gov. Code § 65852.2 for ADU parking. The HCD Handbook (p.13) says ADU law was moved from 65852.2 (and related sections) to Gov. Code §§ 66310-66342. The matching new section is unknown until checked; do not substitute a number.

The city's ADU page lists the Hold Harmless Affidavit for every ADU submittal with no condition, but the form's title limits it to Pre-Approved ADU Plans, and the city's pre-approved plan list currently says 'Coming soon'. None of the four facts records plan choice, so it is NOT entered as a requirement. Shown as needs_information until the city clarifies.

Two decision periods are cited: Irvine's AB 2234 page describes a 30-day review for post-entitlement permits on projects of 25 units or fewer; the HCD Handbook describes 60 days to approve or deny an ADU application (Gov. Code § 66317). They come from different laws with different triggers. Neither statute was opened, so the tool shows both with their sources and calculates no deadline.
